description: Moonshot Kimi K3 / Kimi-for-Coding official capability calibration for the NewAPI Tokyo k3 + kimi routes. Facts captured 2026-09-02 from platform.kimi.ai and kimi.com/code/docs. The registry previously carried no k3 entry at all, so the Pi thinkingLevelMap relied on a hardcoded k3 branch instead of registry evidence.

models.notes: Top-level `reasoning_effort` on Chat Completions accepts low / high / max, default max. Reasoning is always-on (cannot be disabled) — effort only controls depth. Docs warn switching levels invalidates prefix-cache hits, so pick the level before a conversation starts. Reasoning tokens bill as output. 1M context is gated to Allegretto+ membership; k3-256k is the 256K variant. supports_vision intentionally null (not confirmed on pages captured today).

Listed as a Kimi Code model available to all membership tiers. The three-tier reasoning_effort contract is documented for k3 / k3-256k only — NOT claimed for kimi-for-coding. thinking_control left null rather than assumed.

Allegretto+ only per Kimi Code model list. No documented reasoning_effort contract — thinking_control left null rather than assumed. Matches the empirical probe: the Pi thinkingLevelMap carries no levels for this model.
